scenario.topic: Select the launch platform for an indie strategy game

options.name: Steam
options.upside: Large user base with built-in multiplayer features.
options.concern: High distribution fee and competitive market visibility.

options.name: Epic Games Store
options.upside: Lower distribution fees and growing user base.
options.concern: Smaller audience compared to more established platforms.

options.name: GOG.com
options.upside: Focus on DRM-free games and strong single-player community.
options.concern: Limited multiplayer support and smaller user base.

options.name: Itch.io
options.upside: Flexible revenue share and supportive indie community.
options.concern: Smaller user base and less mainstream exposure.

shared_context: A team of five developers is deciding on the initial launch platform for their indie strategy game. The platform must support PC players and allow for both single-player and multiplayer modes.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a game designer focused on narrative-driven single-player experiences.
personas.private_goal: To launch on a platform that values DRM-free and strong single-player communities.

A.reason_for: Large user base and solid multiplayer support.
A.reason_against: High distribution fee and competitive market might overshadow niche single-player focus.

B.reason_for: Lower fees and decent multiplayer support.
B.reason_against: Smaller user base and less focus on single-player community.

C.reason_for: DRM-free focus and strong single-player community align with personal values.

D.reason_for: Flexible revenue share and supportive indie community.
D.reason_against: Very small user base and less mainstream exposure.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a multiplayer programmer passionate about maximizing player reach.
personas.private_goal: To launch on the platform with the largest multiplayer user base and visibility.

A.reason_for: Largest user base and built-in multiplayer features maximize reach.

B.reason_for: Lower fees and growing user base with multiplayer support.
B.reason_against: User base is only half of Steam's.

C.reason_against: Limited multiplayer support and small user base.

D.reason_for: Flexible revenue share and multiplayer support.
D.reason_against: Very small user base and less exposure.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a community manager who values indie-friendly platforms.
personas.private_goal: To support platforms that empower indie developers with flexible terms.

A.reason_for: Large user base and multiplayer support.
A.reason_against: High fees and competitive market may hurt indie visibility.

B.reason_for: Lower fees and decent user base.
B.reason_against: Still less indie-focused than other options.

C.reason_against: Limited multiplayer and small user base.

D.reason_for: Flexible revenue share and very supportive indie community.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a veteran developer prioritizing maximum exposure and revenue.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the game launches on the platform with the highest sales potential.

A.reason_for: Largest user base and strong multiplayer support maximize sales potential.

B.reason_for: Lower fees and growing user base.

C.reason_against: Limited multiplayer and small user base reduce sales potential.

D.reason_against: Very small user base and limited mainstream exposure.

personas.name: Nia
personas.background: Nia is a marketing specialist focused on direct and efficient communication.
personas.private_goal: To pick a platform that balances exposure with straightforward monetization.

A.reason_for: Largest user base and multiplayer support provide best monetization opportunities.

B.reason_for: Lower fees and decent user base.

C.reason_against: Limited multiplayer and small user base reduce reach.

D.reason_for: Flexible revenue share and indie community.
